# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have the defusal manual, which specifies the exact four-step sequence:
1. Cut the purple wire.
2. Press the key that wears 7.
3. Cut the red wire.
4. Press the key that wears 4.

However, I cannot see the bomb, so I do not know which wires are purple or red, nor where keys 7 and 4 are positioned. Furthermore, no sign or protocol has been established yet ("A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something"). Deaf can see the bomb and can speak to the room, so Deaf will be able to describe the visual layout and establish a gesture code for me to respond to. 

At this stage, sending arbitrary gestures would only create confusion. I will wait for Deaf (and Blind) to speak.

```
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I am Blind. Here is what I feel: Strip engraved with [upside-down T], [spiral], [spiral]. Keypad has 4 slots: 1 has digit 1, 2 has digit 4, 3 has digit 7, 4 has digit 2, waiting for 2 digits. There are 6 wire slots. Light and Display exist but I cannot see them. To tell me what to do using gestures (which arrive to me as blanks): First send a turn with gestures for the action type: 1 blank = CUT WIRE, 2 blanks = PRESS KEYPAD. Then in the next turn, send the slot/position numbers (e.g. 3 blanks = slot 3). Please coordinate with Deaf.
Deaf says: Bomb status: Display shows 9. Light is green. Strip is painted red, blue, green. Keypad has 4 buttons: button 1 is 1, button 2 is 4, button 3 is 7, button 4 is 2; it requires 2 digits, currently entered nothing. Wires from 1 to 6: 1 blue, 2 orange, 3 yellow, 4 red, 5 green, 6 purple. Mute, please gesture instructions to me and I will speak them to Blind.

Deaf has provided the wire colors and keypad button values:
- Wire 1: blue, Wire 2: orange, Wire 3: yellow, Wire 4: red, Wire 5: green, Wire 6: purple.
- Button 1: 1, Button 2: 4, Button 3: 7, Button 4: 2.

According to the manual:
1. Cut purple wire -> Wire 6.
2. Press key wearing 7 -> Button 3.
3. Cut red wire -> Wire 4.
4. Press key wearing 4 -> Button 2.

Blind is the only monkey who can manipulate the bomb, and Blind has established a communication protocol using gesture blanks:
- 1 blank = CUT WIRE
- 2 blanks = PRESS KEYPAD
followed on the subsequent turn by the slot number in blanks.

Following Blind's protocol, I will send 1 gesture to Blind to signal CUT WIRE.

```
gesture(to="blind", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Mute: Received 1 blank (Cut Wire). If following my code, send the wire position next turn as that many blanks (e.g. 4 blanks for wire 4). Even better: you can gesture to Deaf, because Deaf can speak out loud to me!
Deaf says: CRITICAL TO MUTE: You cannot speak, and Blind CANNOT see gestures (Blind receives only blanks)! You MUST send gestures to DEAF. Do not use to='blind'. Broadcast or use to='deaf'. I will read your gestures and speak the commands aloud to Blind!
Deaf says: MUTE, USE THIS SIMPLE CODE: To cut a wire, send that many thumbs-up: 👍 = cut wire 1, 👍👍 = cut wire 2, 👍👍👍 = cut wire 3, 👍👍👍👍 = cut wire 4, 5 thumbs-up = wire 5, 6 thumbs-up = wire 6. To press keypad button 1/2/3/4, send that many point-up fingers: ☝ = button 1, ☝☝ = button 2, ☝☝☝ = button 3, ☝☝☝☝ = button 4. Send your gesture now!
Deaf says: BOMB UPDATE: Display is now 6 (was 9). Light is now RED (was green). Keypad still has entered nothing. Strip is red, blue, green. Wires 1-6 are blue, orange, yellow, red, green, purple.

Deaf has provided an explicit gesture code to relay instructions to Blind:
- Wire cutting: N thumbs-up (👍) = cut wire N
- Keypad pressing: N point-up fingers (☝) = press button N

The first step from the manual is to cut the purple wire.
The purple wire is wire 6.
Therefore, I will send 6 thumbs-up gestures to Deaf.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Mute, I told Blind to cut wire 6. Note: Display is currently 0, Light is green. Keypad still needs 2 digits. Strip is red, blue, green. Send next instruction when ready!

Step 1 (cut purple wire, wire 6) was relayed to Blind by Deaf at the end of Turn 3, which Blind will execute during Turn 4.

Step 2 is: "press the key that wears 7".
Button 3 wears 7.
Following Deaf's gesture protocol:
- ☝☝☝ (3 point-up fingers) = press keypad button 3.

I will send this gesture to Deaf so Deaf can instruct Blind on Deaf's turn.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says to Mute: Mute, told Blind to press keypad button 3. Bomb state: Display is 6, Light is yellow. Wire 6 is cut. Next gesture please!

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: key accepted, 1 digits to go
Deaf says to Mute: Mute, told Blind to cut wire 4. bomb state: Display 2, Light blue, Keypad entered 7 (1 digit to go). Send next gesture!

I have instructed cut wire 4 in the previous step, which Deaf relayed to Blind.
The final step is to press the key that wears 4, which is button 2.
Using Deaf's code: 2 point-up fingers (☝☝) = press keypad button 2.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: all required wires are cut
Deaf says to Mute: Mute, instructed Blind to press button 2 on keypad.

All steps from the manual have been relayed:
1. Cut purple wire (Wire 6) - done.
2. Press key wearing 7 (Button 3) - done.
3. Cut red wire (Wire 4) - done.
4. Press key wearing 4 (Button 2) - instructed by Deaf to Blind.

No further instructions remain in the manual. I will wait for Blind to execute the final key press.

```
wait()
```
